pm.test('TC-M02-311 | Sin metricas invalidas ni mezcla de activos',()=>{function walk(o){for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(o||{})){if(k==='id_activo_biologico')pm.expect(v).to.eql(Number(pm.variables.get('id311')));if(typeof v==='number')pm.expect(Number.isFinite(v)).to.eql(true);if(typeof v==='string')pm.expect(v).not.to.match(/^(NaN|[-+]?Infinity)$/);if(k.toLowerCase().includes('peso')&&typeof v==='number')pm.expect(v).to.be.at.least(0);if(v&&typeof v==='object')walk(v);}}walk(body);});
